name: aws-serverless
description: A serverless backend assembled on AWS — Lambda + API Gateway + DynamoDB + Cognito. Deployed per function, with no resident server.

notes.securityBoundary: **There is no row-level policy engine** — DynamoDB has no data-layer enforcement like RLS, so the application-layer authorization check is effectively the only boundary (IAM condition keys can restrict some things but are not a general substitute). Using the BaaS combination's 'defense in depth' wording verbatim is wrong — the guide must be written on the premise that a missing ownership check is a data leak
notes.serverCodeLocation: Lambda handlers (behind API Gateway). Even when the frontend axis has a server runtime, this backend owns the API
notes.runtimeConstraints: Cold starts, per-function IAM roles, an execution time limit, no resident connections — switching to a relational DB makes connection pooling (RDS Proxy, etc.) a mandatory topic
notes.dataModeling: DynamoDB centers on single-table design, partition/sort keys, and GSIs, so the T1 card (relational) lies dormant — write access-pattern-first design directly into the resources
notes.variants: To move to containers (ECS/Fargate + RDS), change backendType to cloud-server and re-fix the DB and data access
